trait.name: Résistance à la magie
entries: The curate has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} aux jets de sauvegarde against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Raise the Dead (1/Day)
entries: In a ritual that takes 8 hours, the curate touches une créature that has died within the past 7 days. That creature returns to life with 1 {@variantrule Touché Points|XPHB|Touché Point}. The curate can't revive une créature that died of old age.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The curate makes three Celestial Radiance attacks.

action.name: Celestial Radiance
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, allonge 5 m, or portée 60 m, {@h}18 ({@dégât 4d8}) Radiantdgts.

action.name: Healer's Touch (2/Day)
entries: The curate touches another creature. That creature regains 13 ({@dice 2d8 + 4}) {@variantrule Touché Points|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amorphe
entries: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Corrosive Form
entries: Whenever une créaturetouchés the ooze with a melee attack, that creature takes 2 Aciddgts.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, allonge 5 m, {@h}10 ({@dégât 2d8 + 1}) Aciddgts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ivlis makes three Chaos Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Sinister Command if available.

action.name: Chaos Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, or portée 60 m, {@h}7 ({@dégât 2d6})dgts. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine thedgts type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

action.name: Sinister Command {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dd 12}, une créature Ivlis can see within 60 mètres. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until la fin de son prochain tour. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, la cible has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Quick Disguise
entries: Jacko spends 1 minute to disguise himself as a different Humanoid of approximately his height and weight. While Jacko is disguised, une créature that takes the Study action to inspect Jacko's appearance can make a {@dd 13}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check, discerning his disguise on a successful check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jacko makes two Poison Dagger attacks.

action.name: Poison Dagger
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, allonge 5 m, or portée 20/60 m, {@h}5 ({@dégât 1d4 + 3}) Piercingdgts plus 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) Poisondgts.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: Jacko takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The kuo-toa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Sensibilité à la lumière du soleil
entries: While in sunlight, the kuo-toa has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} aux tests de caractéristique and attack rolls.

action.name: Brine Slicer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, {@h}9 ({@dégât 2d6 + 2}) Slashingdgts.

bonus.name: Slippery
entries: The kuo-toa takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The lizardfolk can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lizardfolk makes one Bite attack and one Bone Pike attack.

action.name: Morsure
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, {@h}5 ({@dégât 1d6 + 2}) Piercingdgts plus 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) Poisondgts.

action.name: Bone Pike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 10 m, {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d10 + 2}) Piercingdgts.

action.name: Poison Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, portée 60 m, {@h}12 ({@dégât 3d6 + 2}) Poisondgts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Narthus makes two attacks using Vile Mace or Fateful Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Vile Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, {@h}5 ({@dégât 1d6 + 2}) Bludgeoningdgts plus 3 ({@dégât 1d6}) Necroticdgts.

action.name: Fateful Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, portée 120 m, {@h}8 ({@dégât 1d12 + 2}) Necroticdgts, and the next attack roll made against la cible before the end of Narthus's next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, allonge 5 m, {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d8 + 3}) Piercingdgts.

action.name: Light Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, portée 80/320 m, {@h}7 ({@dégât 1d8 + 3}) Piercingdgts.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} Pral is hit with a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} Pral adds 2 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

action.name: Needle Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, allonge 5 m, {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d4 + 4}) Piercingdgts.

action.name: Enchanting Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, portée 40/160 m, {@h}1 Piercingdgts, and la cible has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

action.name: Heart Sight
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dd 10}, une créature within 5 mètres the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, Undead automatically fail the save). {@actSaveFail} The sprite knows la cible's emotions.

action.name: Invisibility
entries: The sprite has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the sprite makes an attack roll or dealsdgts, or if the sprite has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vinx makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Sling in any combination.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, {@h}5 ({@dégât 1d6 + 2}) Piercingdgts.

action.name: Sling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, portée 30/120 m, {@h}4 ({@dégât 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoningdgts.

trait.name: Sensibilité à la lumière du soleil
entries: While in sunlight, the wight has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} aux tests de caractéristique and attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Drink Life.

action.name: Necrotic Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, allonge 5 m, {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d8 + 2}) Slashingdgts plus 4 ({@dégât 1d8}) Necroticdgts.

action.name: Necrotic Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, portée 150/600 m, {@h}6 ({@dégât 1d8 + 2}) Piercingdgts plus 4 ({@dégât 1d8}) Necroticdgts.

action.name: Drink Life {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dd 13}, une créature within 5 mètres. {@actSaveFail} 6 ({@dégât 1d8 + 2}) Necroticdgts, and the wight regains a number of {@variantrule Touché Points|XPHB} equal to the Necroticdgts taken.
